candidates.evidence: Three lines at ~107, ~163 and ~391 cm-1 match tetragonal (P4/nmm) BiOBr: A1g (Bi–Br) ~110, Eg ~160, B1g/Eg (O motion) ~390. The 107 and 163 lines are isotropic and parallel-only. The 391 line is fourfold with the right phase relation.
Same structure type, but the lines would sit near 145 (A1g), 200 (Eg) and 397 cm-1. The strongest line at 107 and the 163 line do not match.
Same structure type, but the A1g would sit near 85–95 cm-1 and the Eg near 145 cm-1. Poor match for 107/163.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given. This is an identification task.

peaks.source: Position and polarization measured from the fit. The A1g assignment is by analogy with the literature BiOBr A1g near 110 cm-1 (Raman studies of BiOX, e.g. Zhang et al.). Parallel amplitude is ~7.7–8.1k counts at all 18 angles. Crossed is at noise level, ~4% of parallel.

peaks.assignment: second Bi–Br mode, assigned Eg by literature analogy
peaks.source: Position and polarization measured. Assignment follows the literature BiOBr Eg near 160 cm-1. The parallel intensity (~1.2–1.5k counts, scatter consistent with noise) is angle-independent and the crossed signal is at noise level. That behaviour is unexpected for a true Eg in backscattering, so the irrep is tentative.

Position and polarization measured. Parallel peaks near 50° and 140° (~2.4k counts) and drops to ~0.3–0.5k at 0°/90°/180°. Crossed is the complement, ~2.3k at 0°/90°/180° and ~0.25k near 50°/140°. This is the cos²(2θ) / sin²(2θ) fourfold signature of a B1g mode with a ~5° axis offset. The literature BiOBr line is near 390 cm-1.

properties.name: layer/structure
properties.value: Tetragonal matlockite-type (P4/nmm) [Bi2O2]2+ / Br– layered structure, bulk-like or thin flake. Layer number not determined.
properties.source: Peak positions compared with the BiOBr literature

properties.name: in-plane crystal axis offset
properties.value: ~5° offset of the B1g fourfold pattern relative to the polarizer zero (parallel maximum near 50°/140°)
properties.source: Angle series fit of the 391 cm-1 line

properties.name: substrate
properties.value: None (suspended). No Si 520.7 cm-1 line is present.

citations: Raman studies of BiOX (X = Cl, Br, I) layered oxyhalides: A1g ~110, Eg ~160 and B1g/Eg ~390 cm-1 for BiOBr (e.g. Zhang et al., and Wu et al., recalled from memory, not re-checked)
Tetragonal P4/nmm Raman selection rules: A1g is parallel-only isotropic. B1g is fourfold, cos²(2θ) parallel and sin²(2θ) crossed.
limits: Very weak features near 207, 261–273, 456 and 485 cm-1 are at or below the noise level, with amplitudes comparable to the scatter. They are not reported as peaks.
Fitted widths are limited by the 1 cm-1 sampling, so they are approximate.

The irrep of the 163 cm-1 line is uncertain. A pure Eg would be forbidden or weak in this geometry, yet the line is isotropic and parallel-only. It could be A1g (second A1g) in the synthetic or real data, so the literature irrep is tentative.
BiOBr is assigned from the line positions and polarization alone, and Cl/I analogues are only disfavoured by position. Layer number, strain and doping cannot be determined from this data.
No cosmic-ray spikes were identified. The largest intensities are all the 107 cm-1 line at consistent values across angles.
